managed-live-final.json.method: Fresh paused managed-live server per trial, full identical catalogs. Binding setup and final exact bindings/input/cursor/zero-native-process oracles excluded. Resume through completed wait/RPC response included: socket/Python/JSON transport, node execution, state budget checks/publication and revision waiting. Two excluded warmups per variant/case, seeded shuffled paired order, warm filesystem. No concurrent builds/tests. No provider or child applet calls. Not CLI startup, isolated interpreter latency, allocation or RSS measurement.

managed-live-final-repeat.json.method: Fresh paused managed-live server per trial, full identical catalogs. Binding setup and final exact bindings/input/cursor/zero-native-process oracles excluded. Resume through completed wait/RPC response included: socket/Python/JSON transport, node execution, state budget checks/publication and revision waiting. Two excluded warmups per variant/case, seeded shuffled paired order, warm filesystem. No concurrent builds/tests. No provider or child applet calls. node.method: Actual preserved release WASM modules, instantiated before timing, serial 3 alternating rounds, 20 warmups then40batches of5 operations. Node operation includes JSON request encode/ABI/Rust/response JSON decode. Chromium operation is the existing worker elapsed clock; roundtrip includes postMessage and scheduling but excludes Playwright evaluation transport. Every batch final response checked against a complete cross-binary hash plus independent output/call-count/FS/trace-cap/UTF8-escaping byte-budget oracles; warmups and fixture/hash checking excluded from timing. Browser clock quantized; batch averages retained, not zero latency. No builds/tests concurrent. No native/OS commands/provider calls; not cold start, memory or Bash comparison.

chromium.method: Actual preserved release WASM modules, instantiated before timing, serial 3 alternating rounds, 20 warmups then40batches of5 operations. Node operation includes JSON request encode/ABI/Rust/response JSON decode. Chromium operation is the existing worker elapsed clock; roundtrip includes postMessage and scheduling but excludes Playwright evaluation transport. Every batch final response checked against a complete cross-binary hash plus independent output/call-count/FS/trace-cap/UTF8-escaping byte-budget oracles; warmups and fixture/hash checking excluded from timing. Browser clock quantized; batch averages retained, not zero latency. No builds/tests concurrent. No native/OS commands/provider calls; not cold start, memory or Bash comparison.
chromium.small_browser_aggregate_method: Additional browser-main-thread ABI control, 100 warmups then40 batches of500 single-applet operations, 3 alternating rounds. Same actual WASM/ABI and exact response hashes. Resolves per-request worker clock quantization; excludes worker/RPC and setup. Not a worker roundtrip.

interpretation: Native runtime API: 1 MiB JSON 117.1 to 96.1 us (-18%); 4 MiB 531.0 to 410.5 us (-22.7%); 64 KiB 18.03 to 16.92 us (-6.1%). Small API controls within 0.8%.
Isolated preflight reductions of 81–99.8% describe private validation work alone; no-input programs without loops already bypass this entry at runtime.
4 MiB API: 78 to 72 allocation requests; 16,786,257 to 12,590,674 requested bytes (-4,195,583, about 25%). All three repeats identical.
Reusable 256-call checkpoint control requests 32 additional bytes for Cow scope storage; all other allocation controls identical. Peak memory and RSS were not measured.
Native executable grows 16,832 bytes (0.58%); WASM artifact sizes are recorded separately.
Cached listener acknowledgements: 472,750 to 471,750 ns for 8-byte records, 511,042 to 510,458 ns for 8,192-byte records. Roughly flat, 3,000 measured samples per variant for each size.
Two managed 32-node repeats: 1–4 MiB medians within 1.7%; small cases vary -5.5% to +6%. No repeatable event gain.
Browser Node ABI controls within 0.6%; Chromium worker controls within 1.4%. Tiny-clock quantization retained; no WASM gain claimed.

Earlier candidate overwrite case measured +3.4% and +7.25%, motivating exclusion of the discarded value from cloning. Final isolated overwrite case -99.27%. Earlier raw samples, source and binaries retained separately.

Local macOS warm filesystem. In-process validation, runtime API, managed execution and listener timing scopes remain distinct. No cold-start, other-platform, Bash, provider inference performance or production-completeness claim.
